first.rationale: Onboarding deterioration is the clearest upstream contributor to the activation decline, and prior evidence indicates that simplification can improve completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. I would verify that evidence alongside activation messaging and promotional pricing before committing, especially because their effects on durable qualified revenue and retention are not fully stated in the consolidated memories.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled experiment simplifying onboarding. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and likely improves the downstream activation shortfall. The verified prior test increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%, making it the strongest option for sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is a credible alternative but had a smaller retention gain. Promotional pricing is rejected because verified retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal.
